title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Explore the best free social and study spots at CUNY Queens College, from art galleries and music performances to quiet library lounges and active recreation spaces.

cards.title: Godwin-Ternbach Museum
cards.subtitle: Klapper Hall, Room 405
cards.notes: View a permanent collection of over 4,000 global art objects. Admission is free for all CUNY students and staff with a valid ID card.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus museum featuring ancient and modern art from around the world.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is open to all CUNY students, faculty and staff with approved entry ID card. Admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Thursday, 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM during the academic semester.

cards.title: Rosenthal Library Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: 65-30 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Access six floors of study carrels and group work areas. Entry requires a valid QCard or CUNY ID for the turnstiles.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering multiple floors of free, quiet study environments for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Library access is limited to currently enrolled CUNY students, faculty and staff with valid CUNY IDs. Entry is free via turnstiles.
cards.source_title: Visiting | Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the semester; check library website for specific floor hours and holiday closures.

cards.title: Open Gym Recreation
cards.subtitle: FitzGerald Gymnasium, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Participate in informal basketball, volleyball, or badminton during scheduled open hours. Bring your own towel for entry.
cards.short_summary: Free indoor athletic recreation for students including basketball and fitness equipment use.
cards.evidence_claim: Open gym procedures for Fall & Spring include basketball courts available Monday-Thursday 12:15 PM - 2:45 PM for students with ID.
cards.access_notes: Open gym hours are typically mid-day; a valid QC ID and proper workout attire are mandatory.

cards.title: Queens College Art Center
cards.subtitle: Rosenthal Library, 6th Floor
cards.notes: Visit this unique rotunda gallery for 3-5 free exhibitions annually featuring emerging and established artists.
cards.short_summary: A public gallery space on the top floor of the library hosting rotating contemporary art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Center offers 3-5 free and public exhibitions per year in its unique rotunda layout.
cards.source_title: Queens College Art Center | School of Arts - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Located on the 6th floor of the Rosenthal Library; accessible during library hours.

cards.title: Student Union Lounges
cards.subtitle: Student Union Building
cards.notes: Relax in various open lounge areas throughout the building. The Union serves as the primary social hub for campus clubs.
cards.short_summary: Free social and relaxation spaces for students to gather between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Union contains major social, cultural, and recreational facilities and is the hub of campus life.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:00 AM to 10:30 PM, and Friday-Sunday 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

cards.title: Free Music Performances
cards.subtitle: Music Building
cards.notes: Attend hundreds of annual concerts, including orchestral and jazz performances, most of which are free for students.
cards.short_summary: A wide variety of free musical performances hosted by the Aaron Copland School of Music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aaron Copland School of Music hosts hundreds of concerts each year, most of which are free to Queens College students.
cards.source_title: Opportunities for Non-Music Majors | Aaron Copland School of Music
cards.access_notes: Check the performance calendar on the ACSM homepage for specific event dates and times.

cards.title: The Campus Quad
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Enjoy the open green space for outdoor studying or socializing. This area hosts major free events like Welcome Day and Fall Fest.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor gathering space for the Queens College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is the site for large-scale events like Welcome Day and concerts sponsored by the Student Association.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space during campus operating hours.

cards.title: Summit Courtyard
cards.subtitle: 64-15 Kissena Blvd
cards.notes: Relax in the lighted outdoor seating areas and courtyards located within the residential complex.
cards.short_summary: Outdoor seating and social areas located at the campus residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Summit Apartments feature amenities including outdoor seating areas and lighted courtyards.
cards.source_title: Floor Plans & Pricing - Summit Apartments - Queens College - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Common areas are primarily for residents, but courtyards are visible and accessible to the campus community.

cards.title: Learning Commons Study Space
cards.subtitle: Kiely Hall, Room 131
cards.notes: Utilize free peer tutoring and open study spaces designed to support student success across various subjects.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student support space offering free tutoring and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: QCLC offers study spaces and workshops free for all Queens College students.
cards.source_title: Queens College Learning Commons - Tutoring, Study Space - CUNY
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic hours; check the QCLC website for specific tutoring schedules.

cards.title: Newman Center Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Union, Room 208
cards.notes: Visit the open student lounge for socializing and relaxation. The center is open to all students regardless of faith.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming multi-faith social space located within the Student Union.
cards.evidence_claim: The office provides an open student lounge where all students can socialize and relax.
cards.source_title: Religion & Spirituality - Student Development and Leadership
cards.access_notes: Typically open Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
